Subject: EnergyHealth MAP: Eval launchpad & POC access checklist

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the time today. As discussed, I’m putting the mutual action plan (MAP) items we need to get your evaluation environment live and on a 6-week close cadence. I’ve attached a working MAP spreadsheet (EnergyHealth_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a short SOW draft for the activation window (Activation_SOW_EH.pdf).

High level asks for POC environment (aim: week 1 activation):
- Org setup: Create EnergyHealth org in our console and invite two dev users (dev1@energyhealth.com, dev2@energyhealth.com)
- API keys: Request API key creation + test token for sandbox (rotate schedule: 90 days)
- IP allowlist: Provide CIDR ranges for allowlist and any jumpbox IPs we should expect
- VPC peering: Confirm VPC owner contact + preferred peering window (we typically schedule a 2-hour window for peering handshake)

Could you confirm the IP ranges and whether you want us to initiate the peering request from our side or if you’ll open a support ticket with your cloud ops team? Once you confirm, we’ll schedule the network window and lock milestone dates into the MAP.

Next steps I recommend:
1) You confirm IP ranges and peering owner by Tue 04/23 EOD
2) We create the org + stub API keys and share test tokens within 24 hours of confirmation
3) Test a short end-to-end (generate -> latencies -> logs) during the peering window

Feel free to add any missing items to the attached MAP.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
